scoring_justification: The agent submits the final computed quantities; the checker recomputes the exact expected values from the public formulas and constants, then compares the agent's reported values to these hidden gold values within tight tolerance, plus structural ordering.

outputs.description: Contains the computed critical cluster sizes (g1*, g2*) and critical free energies (ΔF1*, ΔF2*) for nucleation on the metal–gas and metal–soot interfaces, expressed as defined in the paper.

hidden_assets.purpose: expected values for critical sizes and free energies computed analytically from public formulas and parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: derived from paper equations (7), (8) and ΔF* relation with fixed parameters T=1000K, S=10, σ=1 J/m2, vA=8.8e-30 m3, k=1.380649e-23 J/K
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are deterministic consequences of given public inputs; the agent must independently compute same expressions
